Vaal Righteous Fire can drop from the Vaal Vessels found in [[Vaal side area]]s. |is_drop_restricted = true |is_corrupted = True |release_version = 1.1.5 }} '''Vaal Righteous Fire''' is a [[Vaal skill|vaal]] [[spell]] that expends a percentage of your [[energy shield]] and [[life]] to [[burn]] surrounding enemies for a short period of time, relative to how much life and energy shield was spent. ==Skill Functions and Interactions== '''On-hit effects''': The damage you do to yourself when Using Vaal Righteous Fire is not considered a hit on yourself. Thus it will not proc any when-hit effects. For the same reason, it does not interrupt energy shield recharge. '''Spell Totem''': Vaal Righteous Fire cannot be supported by {{il|Spell Totem}}, as it is a Vaal Skill. '''Duration Modifiers''': Vaal Righteous fire now has the Duration tag, allowing it to be linked to and fully benefit from support gems such as {{il|Efficacy Support}}, {{il|Increased Duration}} and {{il|Less Duration}}. '''Righteous Fire''': The buffs and damage from Vaal Righteous Fire do not interfere with or stop Righteous Fire, both skills may be used simultaneously. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression | c1_abbr = Damage
